notes: From the FY2025 Form 10-K (year ended Dec 31, 2025), the first after DuPont distributed its electronics business (Qnity Electronics) on Nov 1, 2025; the 10-K's two continuing segments are Healthcare & Water Technologies and Diversified Industrials, and it also reports the pending sale of the Aramids business to Arclin (7 of the 82 sites and about 1,700 of the approximately 15,000 employees are dedicated to Aramids). All figures are therefore much smaller than the FY2024 snapshot (110 sites, ~24,000 employees, $5,768 million long-lived assets). DuPont reports manufacturing sites and employee shares by four regions only; 'U.S. & Canada' is defined by its name, the other regions have no country list (EMEA is footnoted as Europe, Middle East, and Africa). Site totals can count a site more than once when several segments use it. Employee shares are percentages and are not converted into headcounts. Long-lived assets are filed separately for the United States and Canada, so they sit on country rows while the 'U.S. & Canada' region carries sites and employees; the 10-K also footnotes Luxembourg long-lived assets of $784 million (inside EMEA, not recorded as a row). The 10-K names only the Wilmington headquarters; no list of plants, no state breakdown and no country-by-country tax report were found in it.
